notes.title: DEMO UPDATE V168 - Hot Air Balloon & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

As of this post going live, Demo V168, otherwise known as the HOT AIR Update is now live! This introduces a bunch of bug fixes as well as the brand new HOT AIR BALLOON Level!

[h2]HOT AIR BALLOON[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310951/0962d1efa75fd43c305fc5744ef968eeff9769db.png[/img]

The Hot Air Balloon level consists of a smaller main playspace at the top of the balloon as well as the ropes circling around a wide area. 
Compared to the Sanctum Bridge level you will notice that weapon and Powerup spawn potentials have been reduced to help with the smaller main playspace whilst still retaining the chaotic nature of the gameplay.

We also introduce an entirely new mechanic with this level, CLIMBING:
Fall onto or move towards the ropes below the top to get into climbing across and over the entire balloon.
[list]
[*] Use the Left Analog Stick/WASD to move around the roped area, climb back up to the top to get back into the chaos
[*] Unique attacks are available for all the existing inputs for attacks whilst climbing, try knocking off an enemy (or your friend!)
[*] Escape from the chaos above, but be warned that the chaos might follow you!
[/list]
We're excited to bring you this brand new level for you to play, to commemorate this we will be having a Livestream at 3PM GMT (not a prerecord!) where you can come play with the developers. If you want a better chance of participating come and [url=
https://discord.gg/DN4n4SGGSp]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url]
[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
With a new update comes a nice list patch notes for you to get your teeth into:
[list]
[*] Mini Size player will no longer remain mini scale with regular sized attacks if they die whilst attach attacking another player
[*] Returning to normal from Super Size will not cause player to remain at Super Size speed
[*] Detaching from Mini Size Attach attacks to head and leg will no longer cause player to be sent out of the world
[*] Jump attacks whilst Mini Size will no longer cause player to become stuck
[*] Increased damage for Mini Size Attach attacks
[*] Breaking a Weapon Crate whilst Mini Size will no longer make the player slower speed
[*] Weapon Crates will no longer float in the air if whilst dropping a player is blocking the landing location
[*] Being attacked whilst Grappling or Pickup/Throwing players will not cause the other player to be stuck to you permanently
[/list]
[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Being punted can sometimes lock the player in place at the end of the animation
[*] New players can encounter an unintended character colour when customising for the first time
[*] Large amounts of knockback can cause positional desync between players
[*] Judo Throw whilst grabbing will not send the attacked player in the intended direction
[*] Crates thrown by Clients will destroy immediately.
[*] HOT AIR BALLOON - Horse will occasionally clip though geometry and have collision issues
[*] HOT AIR BALLOON Not having Temporal AA Enabled can cause graphical issues with clouds
[/list]

We're thankful for everybody who has played the demo up until this point, and hope you share it with your friends and others on Socials.
- PH Crew

notes.title: Next Fest Update: Patches, New Level & MORE!
notes.content:
Howdy there! 

Now we've been live on Steam next Fest for 24 hours it's about time we give an update on a few things, but first:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310951/b34c605a55c717ce5815be8ec690f0425b1b43a4.png[/img]

[h3]Berwick VS Cow is now live streaming on our store page, we had a great time playing with Ricky and hope you enjoy this monumental clash of titans![/h3]

[h2][b]STATE OF THE DEMO[/b][/h2]

We're currently in preparations to update the demo with some much needed bug fixes, here is a preview of some of the full Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Detaching from Minisize Attach attacks to head and leg will no longer cause player to be sent out of the world
[*] Increased damage for Minisize Attach attacks
[*] When returning to normal size from Supersize, player will no longer have Supersize speed
[*] Jump attacks whilst minisize will no longer cause player to become stuck
[/list]

As well as fixing some issues, we'll also be including a BRAND NEW LEVEL for you to play in the next Demo update.

[h2]High in the sky, you find yourself mysteriously dropped on the top of a HOT AIR BALLOON![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310951/0962d1efa75fd43c305fc5744ef968eeff9769db.png[/img]

This level introduces a smaller main playspace as well as a brand new feature: CLIMBING!
You can climb along the roped area of the Balloon and even fight whilst traversing it. This can make for great last second escapes or recoveries from other players bringing the mayhem to you but be warned, it's a very steep drop onto the land below! (We checked it, the balloon is 5000 feet up in the sky!)

We hope to bring this update to you soon, keep your eyes peeled on our Community Hub for more information when it goes LIVE!

<3 PH Crew

notes.title: RNT: Mayhem Demo Release
notes.content:
Welcome to your first taste of MAYHEM! The Ruff 'N' Tumble: Mayhem Demo is now LIVE as part of Steam Next Fest.

The demo only shows a very small slice of gameplay, staged across a few regions, giving you a taste of the insanity we aim to deliver in the full game. You will laugh, you will cry, you will be astonished! Download the demo and experience the ridiculous world of Ruff ‘N’ Tumble: Mayhem!

We'll be streaming on our store page here at multiple times across the Next Fest:
[list]
[*]Developers of Ruff ‘N’ Tumble: Mayhem play the demo (LIVE) on Steam | 21/02/22 | 10 PM (GMT) / 5 PM (EST)
[*]Ricky Berwick VS THE COW (LIVE) on Steam | 22/02/22 | 6 PM (GMT) / 1 PM (EST)
[/list]

We will also be hosting a play session with members of our Discord on the 28th February at 6PM GMT / 1PM EST

[h1][url=
https://discord.gg/DN4n4SGGSp]Ruff 'N' Tumble: Mayhem Discord[/url][/h1]

[b]Demo v160 Known Issues[/b]

[list]
[*] Being interrupted whilst picking up a player can cause the picked up player to be permanently attached
[*] Camera can become detached from the player at the point of death
[*] Two players performing a Special attack at the same time can cause any hit players to be stuck
[*] Cannot force start from the lobby with Keyboard input
[*] After shrinking from super size, player retains slow speed
[/list]

We are working to fix these issues listed above so please keep this in mind during your games. And if you want to help us out just hit the bug report button on the Main Menu (in the top right).

We will soon update the demo with new content (shh, it's a secret!) as well as Bug Fixes across this coming week.


-  <3 PH
